title: How to remove limescale from taps

pieces.say: Your taps are crusty, and you know it.
pieces.text: Your taps are crusty, and you know it.
pieces.label: LIMESCALE ALERT

pieces.say: Here's the trick. Wrap them in a vinegar cloth.
Soak a cloth in white vinegar and wrap the tap.
Leave it thirty minutes to an hour.
Scrub the crust off with an old toothbrush.
Not on stone or coated taps, and never mix cleaners.
Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.

elevenlabsPrompt:
[playful] Your taps are crusty, and you know it.

[intrigued] Here's the trick. Wrap them in a vinegar cloth.

[friendly] Soak a cloth in white vinegar and wrap the tap. Leave it thirty minutes to an hour. Scrub the crust off with an old toothbrush. Rinse, then buff it dry. Not on stone or coated taps, and never mix cleaners.

[delighted] Shiny taps, zero scrubbing marathon.

[warm] Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
